name: Jenkins MCP Server
description: Enables comprehensive Jenkins automation through MCP interface, allowing users to manage builds, jobs, artifacts, and queues with natural language commands. Supports build triggering, monitoring, artifact retrieval, and system status checks with automatic CSRF protection and authentication.
